otherCandidates.reason: The current gate and ADR0021 select direct SIWC Responses for Hermes and reserve Codex exec/app-server for delegated agents. These assertions require a first-party CLI/app-server compatibility/authentication path, including refresh/restart and account-dependent checks; the existing delegation executor is not that subprocess seam. Do not fabricate authorization or switch routes to satisfy the older wording.

The saved unbound-SIWC public CLI diagnostic has exact run/show readbacks but both operations remain NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Its checks show an unauthorized synthetic grant and no fallback; they do not create an auxiliary task or exercise exhausted usage, durable obligations, reset/top-up actions, or provider availability. It is not either assigned AT.

The current AT40 proof already covers a cancelled-after-output stream, local 4096 estimate, pending/uncertain usage, null provider cap, actual HTTP close/cancel, and retained/read-back durable charge. ModelRouteProbe's fixed request guard rejects max_output_tokens in the external request. The separate AT58 assertion is not registered or independently run, but no second stream fixture or accounting implementation is justified by this review.
